1. Layout only, and in a stricter sense than the rest of the
set: every figured dimension here is this project's and
exact, and everything hatched is a build-up nobody has
specified yet. The hatched zones are drawn at a plausible
thickness so the junction can be read; none of those
2. Each hatched zone names the QS-003 topic that has to
answer for it. Until that topic is answered the detail
cannot be built, priced or warranted, and no quantity is
3. The 300 mm structural zone is ours because it sets the
floor-to-floor; how much of it is slab, and what is in the
slab, is the engineer's. No reinforcement, cover or grade
4. Thermal performance, waterproofing warranty, movement and
buildability are the specifier's. The drawing shows where
things meet, not that the meeting works.
5. D1 is the junction the whole frontage depends on, and it
is the one carrying a 2.00 m cantilever: read it with
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
P21 2026-10-07 300 mm external and party walls: brick, colour unrestricted
P22 2026-10-08 A-300 to A-302 withdrawn: enlargements of a building not being built
